none: PAS CAM-B6FDA6: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361 (Reece 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows 2 soldiers, two standards. Mint is uncertain, c. AD 330-337. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows a bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.49g, diameter is 15.6mm, thickness is 1.4mm
